// PrimitiveIndices is the leaf-order permutation of the caller's primitives.
// Instances come from BuildBvh (spatial-structures.library.plato) or from a
// host that emits the same encoding.
type Bvh3D
    implements IValue, ISpatialIndex3D, IRaycast3D
